Egypt FA Criticizes Officiating in Argentina Loss; FIFA Rejects Bias Claims

Egypt's national football team has criticized the officiating during their World Cup loss to Argentina, with the coach alleging they were 'cheated' and the FA stating they 'cannot remain silent'. The controversy centers on alleged VAR inconsistency. FIFA's refereeing chief has rejected claims of bias.
